metadata.question: Are there more red flowers visible on April 21, 2018, than on May 7, 2018, in Keukenhof Garden in the Netherlands?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need high-resolution imagery to see flowers in Keukenhof Garden. - Use Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m RGB/NIR) because it has 10 m resolution and frequent revisits. - Date filters: 2018-04-21 ±1 day and 2018-05-07 ±1 day. - Location: a small 500 m buffer around the well-known point 4.5489°E, 52.2713°N (Keukenhof main gate). 2. Masking: Mask clouds and cloud shadows with the Sentinel-2 QA60 band and SCL band (to keep only clear land pixels). 3. Flower proxy: red flowers strongly absorb green and reflect red, so we can use the Red-band reflectance (B4) as a proxy for “red flower signal”. Compute mean B4 inside the garden mask (a small polygon) for each date. Also count valid pixels after masking to detect C2. 4. Logic: - If either date has 0 images → C1. - After masking, if either date has 0 valid pixels → C2. - If Red_mean_Apr21 > Red_mean_May7 → A (Yes), else B (No). - If any computed mean is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Keukenhof Garden area (rough polygon around the park) keuk = ee.Geometry.Point([4.5489, 52.2713]).buffer(500) garden = keuk # use simple buffer as garden mask # 2. Sentinel-2 surface reflectance def get_col(d): return (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate(ee.Date(d).advance(-1,'day'), ee.Date(d).advance(1,'day')) .filterBounds(garden) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20))) col_apr = get_col('2018-04-21') col_may = get_col('2018-05-07') n_apr = col_apr.size().getInfo() n_may = col_may.size().getInfo() print(f"Apr 21 Images: {n_apr}") print(f"May 07 Images: {n_may}") if n_apr == 0 or n_may == 0: print("C1") # 3. Cloud mask & red-band mean def red_mean(col): img = col.first() qa = img.select('QA60') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11)) mask = img.select('SCL').eq(4).And(cloud.Not()) red = img.select('B4').updateMask(mask) cnt = red.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=garden, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4').getInfo() mean = red.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=garden, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4').getInfo() return mean, cnt mean_apr, cnt_apr = red_mean(col_apr) mean_may, cnt_may = red_mean(col_may) print(f"Valid pixels Apr: {cnt_apr}, May: {cnt_may}") if cnt_apr == 0 or cnt_may == 0: print("C2") print(f"Mean Red Apr: {mean_apr:.3f}, May: {mean_may:.3f}") # 4. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Keukenhof Garden area (rough polygon around the park)
keuk = ee.Geometry.Point([4.5489, 52.2713]).buffer(500)
garden = keuk  # use simple buffer as garden mask

# 2. Sentinel-2 surface reflectance
def get_col(d):
    return (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
              .filterDate(ee.Date(d).advance(-1,'day'), ee.Date(d).advance(1,'day'))
              .filterBounds(garden)
              .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)))

col_apr = get_col('2018-04-21')
col_may = get_col('2018-05-07')

n_apr = col_apr.size().getInfo()
n_may = col_may.size().getInfo()
print(f"Apr 21 Images: {n_apr}")
print(f"May 07 Images: {n_may}")
if n_apr == 0 or n_may == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Cloud mask & red-band mean
def red_mean(col):
    img = col.first()
    qa = img.select('QA60')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11))
    mask = img.select('SCL').eq(4).And(cloud.Not())
    red = img.select('B4').updateMask(mask)
    cnt = red.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=garden, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4').getInfo()
    mean = red.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=garden, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4').getInfo()
    return mean, cnt

mean_apr, cnt_apr = red_mean(col_apr)
mean_may, cnt_may = red_mean(col_may)
print(f"Valid pixels Apr: {cnt_apr}, May: {cnt_may}")
if cnt_apr == 0 or cnt_may == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

print(f"Mean Red Apr: {mean_apr:.3f}, May: {mean_may:.3f}")

# 4. Decision
if mean_apr is None or mean_may is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif mean_apr > mean_may:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
